deviations: TOKENIZER IS NOT WORDPIECE (doc-vs-reality, important): PHASE_02 ss2.2 and the dispatch say 'WordPiece', but the actual convaiinnovations/laya checkpoint (rev 55cf4c4ebb4ebe31b2550e8bdf3bd21b99753851) ships a GPT-2-style tokenizer — NFC normalizer, ByteLevel pre-tokenizer (GPT-2 regex), BPE model (50280 vocab, 50009 merges) + 116 added tokens; there is no WordPiece/[UNK] anywhere in its tokenizer.json. The binding correctness criterion (Gate 2.2: 100% exact match on reference vectors from the receptron/laya reference's library) is only satisfiable by porting the REAL tokenizer, so that is what was built (Tokenizer.kt documents this at the top). A literal BERT-style WordPiece port would produce token ids that disagree with the checkpoint and would make the Phase-8 shadow meaningless. Vision 05 ss6 names the receptron port (which runs HF tokenizers on the same tokenizer.json) as the reference — the implementation follows the reference, which is the law's intent.

Tokenizer provenance (build-time download only; no runtime network): tokenizer.json downloaded verbatim from https://huggingface.co/convaiinnovations/laya/resolve/55cf4c4ebb4ebe31b2550e8bdf3bd21b99753851/tokenizer/tokenizer.json (repo revision 55cf4c4ebb4ebe31b2550e8bdf3bd21b99753851; file sha256 6c8aaa9a542084f2457eab775d4eeb51f92a70c0fd9de28d5edb0ddec3c08d30 — byte-identical to the working copy) and committed at core/src/main/resources/laya/tokenizer.json (3,583,228 bytes) + core/src/main/resources/laya/PROVENANCE.txt (license Apache-2.0). uv (astral-sh, .tools/uv.exe, gitignored) WORKED on this Windows box; reference vectors are REAL tokenizer output — 33 text->ids pairs generated by .tools/gen_vectors.py via 'uv run --no-project --with tokenizers python gen_vectors.py' through huggingface tokenizers (the receptron reference's library), committed at core/src/test/resources/tokenizer/reference-vectors.json. NOT the hand-derived fallback — evidence is strong. Texts cover URL+punctuation+query, mixed case, numbers, long concatenated words, Finnish/accented/Cyrillic/CJK non-ASCII, whitespace runs, added-token literals (|||IP_ADDRESS||| etc.), special-token literals, and an NFC-D/NFC-C twin pair.

Vocab resource shape: phase doc ss2.2 names 'core/src/test/resources/tokenizer/vocab-sample.txt'; the full vocab ships as the verbatim tokenizer.json under src/main/resources/laya/ (better provenance than a sample alone), and vocab-sample.txt exists as the named auditable sample (333 entries: ids 0-199, every 2500th id, all 116 added tokens) with a validation test (TokenizerVocabSampleTest) that cross-checks every entry against the committed tokenizer.json.

Nav-links vs buttons classifier (v1, deterministic): a11y nodes carry Android class names, not DOM roles, so 'links believed to navigate' (vision 03 ss3's own wording) is implemented as: editable -> form-fields; clickable non-editable with 'button' in the class name (android.widget.Button/ImageButton) -> buttons; every other clickable non-editable node -> nav-links (WebView exposes anchors/headings-with-links as clickable views without button semantics). Gating of high-stakes fields stays out of enumeration (Phase 4).

Scroll actions: emitted as one scroll-down + scroll-up pair PER scrollable container (vision 03 ss3 'scroll actions (down/up on scrollable containers)', plural), ids 'scroll-down@<node id>'/'scroll-up@<node id>', centered on the container (gesture-dispatch convention, vision 03 ss2). All committed fixtures have <=4 scrollables so the 20-cap never bites in practice; overflow would truncate by the same ranking.

Flat<=255 cap is structurally unreachable through enumerate() (6 buckets x 20 = 120 < 255); the cap is still enforced defensively in CandidateList.init (loud failure, tested) and the enumerator's flat-cap code path is kept for law compliance — noted so the verifier does not mistake it for dead speculation.

State-text compression semantics: 'drop lowest-rank candidates within buckets until fit' implemented as global ranking tail removal (each drop removes one candidate from its bucket; kept set is always the deterministic ranking's head prefix). Builder NEVER truncates app-authored content (ART-4 lines stay verbatim, whitespace-flattened): if even an empty UNTRUSTED PAGE CONTENT block cannot fit <=480 tokens it throws IllegalStateException (phase doc ss2.3 'asserts never-exceed') — the llm page-compressor role (vision 03 ss4) is Phase 10's escape hatch, not ours.

HISTORY digest: template allows <=3 lines; builder keeps the MOST RECENT 3 digest lines (latest context matters most for a decider), each rendered as its own 'HISTORY: <line>' app-authored line; empty history renders 'HISTORY: (none)'.

Prior untracked Phase-2 partial work found in the tree (Candidate/ObservedNode types, Tokenizer port, tokenizer resource, reference vectors, Gate 2.2 test — no phase-2 status file existed): validated against spec, kept, fixed and completed rather than rewritten. One real bug was found and fixed during gate hardening: the enumerator derived sourceOrder from input list position, violating shuffled-input invariance (now reads the node's field; the Gate 2.1 shuffle test is the regression guard).
